I’m proud to lead the Continuing Systems of Care for Children Act. Our youth are struggling with mental health and substance abuse disorders.

This bill would reauthorize proven programs and resources that improve treatment outcomes for our community members who need help. https://t.co/74y2TR4MSQ
We must avoid disastrous cuts to Medicare that would harm patients across #PA13.
In Congress, I have been a strong supporter of preserving Social Security and Medicare for our nation's seniors. These programs are not bargaining chips. https://t.co/n0WEjCDUkp

On March 2, 1993 Mario Lemieux came back from receiving treatment for Hodgkin’s Lymphoma and played against the the Philadelphia Flyers. 

I salute all those who are fighting cancer and all the strong families behind them. https://t.co/5PSONEr99j

Conemaugh Nason's Cath lab offers emergency and life-saving care cardiac care. Thank you to Tim Harclerode for the tour and the excellent work your team is doing to support patients in #PA13. https://t.co/WEj65955c8

Today, thousands of fourth-year medical students will learn what hospitals they will go to after graduation. Best of luck to all these students - thank you for your commitment to serving our communities. https://t.co/E5ecq4C02F

UPMC Bedford is celebrating its 25th anniversary, and being named among 100 top-preforming rural and community hospitals for 2023! Congratulations to all UPMC Bedford doctors, nurses, and healthcare workers who support a healthy Bedford community. https://t.co/BQ9dtvD77g

Patients who have experienced a cardiac event shouldn't have to spend unnecessary time in hospitals. That's why I introduced H.R.1406 which would allow patients to continue receiving in-home cardiac and pulmonary rehabilitation services under Medicare. https://t.co/Z2isajhQ3D

Community Health Centers serve over 230,000 patients across our district. I'm proud to have introduced legislation to reauthorize these centers and ensure they can continue to provide care for years to come. https://t.co/H5mgMHtGSQ

The @HouseGOP's Limit, Save, Grow Act of 2023 would save American families trillions of dollars over the next 10 years, and work to curb high inflation—all while protecting Social Security and Medicare benefits for seniors.

Doctors, not political activists, should make healthcare policy. Today, I questioned AFT President Randi Weingarten on her union's decision to advocate for school closings that left students behind in reading and math. https://t.co/eDsmBChIhp

Returning spending levels to 2022 is not radical, no matter what the far-left says. The Limit, Save, Grow Act will protect America's future by blocking unmitigated spending while fully protecting Medicare, Social Security, and support for Veterans.

Today, @COVIDSelect will hold a hearing on state mandates that forced nursing homes and long-term care facilities to admit contagious COVID-19 patients leading to the deaths of more than 35,000 Americans. Watch here: https://t.co/rRhM7vbgP3

Excited that my legislation to re-authorize Community Health Centers has passed out of @HouseCommerce.  This legislation would ensure that the 200,000 people in #PA13 that rely on Community Health Centers are still able to access quality healthcare. https://t.co/Rx8ypZzqxn

It was great to meet family doctors from our district and discuss what Congress can do to ensure their patients have access to high-quality care.  These physicians provide the care needed for our communities to thrive! https://t.co/NvXS0HWV85
Today, thousands of new physicians will begin their residency programs.  Good luck to all the new doctors serving patients in rural areas across #PA13!

Today, @COVIDSelect held a hearing on a widely read medical paper that was altered after discussions with Dr. Fauci. I asked Dr. Andersen why his research stating that a lab leak was not plausible contradicts information from our Intelligence Community. https://t.co/xhzgilX6mo

So far, @HouseGOP has passed legislation to REIN in over-spending, END the COVID-19 Public Health Emergency, SECURE our southern border, and LOWER energy costs. Our Committment to America means fighting for ALL Americans.

Recently, I visited the Van Zandt VA to celebrate the opening of a third operating room! Subscribe to my weekly newsletter to keep up with my community involvement. For more coverage on this trip, you can read the piece from the Express linked below: https://t.co/CPNXiaigiO https://t.co/1gsn368CfA

ICYMI- The Department of Health and Homeland Security suspended funding to the Wuhan Institute of Virology JUST THIS WEEK. The Biden Administration should have cut funding after reports of taxpayer dollars going towards risky bio-research.
This week, I introduced bipartisan legislation with Rep. Schrier to encourage and support medical innovation to develop treatments and cures for pediatric cancer. https://t.co/IHSKy5eI9H

Today, I questioned Health and Human Services Secretary Becerra on why there are discrepancies with how hospital price transparency is enforced. You can watch my line of questioning below: https://t.co/z19I8absZ3
ICYMI- Last week, I introduced legislation with Rep. Schrier to encourage and support medical innovation for developing treatments and cures for pediatric cancer. Read more: https://t.co/fQhozpM4Eg

Fulton County Medical Center is unveiling their brand new Clinical Education Suite and Wellness Center designed to provide our health care providers with the tools and experience they need to help treat us and heal. Thank you for showing me the facility! https://t.co/yM7eI2YXvI

During National Health Center Week we recognize the work done by Community Health Centers to serve over 30 million Americans with essential services ranging from pediatric checkups to dental care. In Congress, I'm proud to be leading legislation to reauthorize these centers.
